# What a user does and sees (compat/apps.rs): each case after its tap.
# base-status-bar
tap id:case-base-status-bar
# platform is told to show: nsh.json's default under the layers of the
# pages and dialogs in the tree, the latest winning field by field.
expect Plain page
# nsh.json's default alone: the root page sets none.
statusbar foreground=dark hidden=true animated=false
# A page over it sets `foreground` only: `hidden` stays nsh.json's.
tap text:Push first
expect First page
statusbar foreground=light hidden=true animated=false
# The next sets `hidden` only: the page below's `foreground` stays.
tap text:Push second
expect Second page
statusbar foreground=light hidden=false animated=false
# A dialog over the pages, animated.
tap text:Open dialog
expect Dialog content
statusbar foreground=auto hidden=false animated=true
# Closing it takes its layer away.
tap text:Close dialog
absent Dialog content
statusbar foreground=light hidden=false animated=false
# Popping takes the pages' away, down to nsh.json's default.
tap text:Pop
expect Routes: plain > first
statusbar foreground=light hidden=true animated=false
tap text:Pop
expect Routes: plain
statusbar foreground=dark hidden=true animated=false
covers [props] statusBar
covers [nsh:rt] setup

# base-transition-shader
tap id:case-base-transition-shader
# Pages and a dialog with a `transitionShader` come and go as without one:
# the headless runtime presents nothing and renders no pixels. Each prop
# reaches the core, which warns of the uniform its program does not
# declare.
expect Page home
tap text:Push details
expect Page details
log uniform `pageTint`
tap text:Open dialog
expect Shader dialog
log uniform `dialogTint`
tap text:Close dialog
absent Shader dialog
tap text:Pop
expect Page home
absent Page details
covers [props] transitionShader
# base-hover-card
tap id:case-base-hover-card
# `defaultOpen`: open at first; a press outside closes it.
expect OwnCard
touch start text:Elsewhere 5 5
touch end
absent OwnCard
# A phone has no pointer to rest: a press on the trigger opens it, above
# the trigger (20, 300), 6 points away, lined up by its start but kept 30
# points from the edge; the app's class and style.
tap id:mention
expect AdaCard
expect Log: card true triggerPress
expect Life: card open
expect Side: top
frame parent:text:AdaCard 30 254 120 40
style parent:text:AdaCard backgroundColor #123456ff
# The trigger again closes it.
tap id:mention
absent AdaCard
expect Log: card false triggerPress
expect Life: card closed
# A press outside closes it, and so do Escape and back.
tap id:mention
expect AdaCard
touch start text:Elsewhere 5 5
touch end
absent AdaCard
expect Log: card false pressOutside
tap id:mention
expect AdaCard
event text:AdaCard onCancel
absent AdaCard
expect Log: card false cancel
covers [nsh/base] HoverCard
covers [props] HoverCard.open
covers [props] HoverCard.defaultOpen
covers [props] HoverCard.placement
covers [props] HoverCard.align
covers [props] HoverCard.offset
covers [props] HoverCard.margin
covers [props] HoverCard.popupClass
covers [props] HoverCard.popupStyle
covers [props] HoverCard.trigger
covers [events] HoverCard.onOpenChange
covers [events] HoverCard.onOpen
covers [events] HoverCard.onClose
covers [events] HoverCard.onPosition
# base-terminal
tap id:case-base-terminal
# The output, its color and moves interpreted: `d` replaced the first
# line's `n`; the title the program set; the size once laid out.
expect red lide
expect second
expect Title Build
expect Size truextrue
# What the user types goes to the app as data.
type label:Shell ls
expect Typed [ls]
# The ref's text, then a reset clears it.
tap id:read
expect Typed [red lide]
tap id:reset
absent second
covers [nsh/base] Terminal
covers [props] accessibilityLabel

covers [events] Terminal.onResize
